Code Guidance

sections.title: Validation
sections.text:
Rename and type change on both engines; expand→switch→contract atomically changes current reservations while preserving all revisions; rollback restores the prior projection; kill/retry every stage;
concurrent write preserved; digest mismatch blocks switch; rollback before/after switch.
